name: Validate HexAST Sandbox & Gas Limit Safety
description: Automatically audits core VM, AST, and AI compiler changes on save to guarantee zero eval() usage and strict 10,000-step gas metering.

action.prompt: Audit the saved file against .kiro/steering/tech.md: 1) Verify that eval(), new Function(), or dynamic script tags are NEVER used. 2) Ensure every statement and expression evaluation path in src/core/vm.ts increments the instruction step counter and halts at 10,000 steps. 3) Verify that sharedText semantics on HexFieldPart read/write to HexCard.bgFieldContents[fieldId] when sharedText is false.
